title: Graph Execution Engine
summary: This module provides a robust framework for defining, executing, and managing complex computational graphs. It includes core components for graph construction, stateful execution, and mechanisms for persisting graph state to ensure reliability and recoverability.

nodes.label: Core Graph Logic
nodes.title: Graph Definition & Execution
nodes.description: Defines the fundamental components for building, executing, and managing directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), including nodes, graph definition, runtime execution, and path construction.

nodes.label: Graph State Persistence
nodes.title: Graph State Management
nodes.description: Provides abstract and concrete mechanisms for persisting the state of graph runs, enabling tracking of execution progress and recovery across sessions.
